evaluation.safety_evals: The developer reports that rigorous filtering for child sexual abuse material was applied at multiple stages of data preparation to exclude harmful and illegal content.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: image-text-to-text model trained on 11T tokens with no reported factuality or grounding evaluation -> plausible hallucination in generated text

possible_risks.description: A model might generate language that leads to physical harm.  The language might include overtly violent, covertly dangerous, or otherwise indirectly unsafe statements.
possible_risks.justification: gated multimodal checkpoint with only CSAM filtering reported and no other safety evaluation -> plausible harmful text output

possible_risks.description: Manipulative prompts that use social engineering techniques, such as role-playing or hypothetical scenarios, to persuade the model into generating harmful content.
possible_risks.justification: instruct-tuned chat model with no reported robustness evaluation against manipulative prompts -> plausible social engineering jailbreak

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: image and text input modality plus gated access does not prevent users from including copyrighted material in prompts -> plausible IP-in-prompt risk

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: image and text input modality with no data-protection controls stated -> plausible confidential data in prompts

specifications.model_size: 10.1 GiB of safetensors weights (10,879,085,840 bytes) in BF16

training_context.training_data: The model was trained on a large corpus of diverse sources totaling approximately 11 trillion tokens.
